name: Summit AZ - Early Performance Check 2026-10-05
body:
> Report · Summit Az · 2026-10-05

# Summary
First read on the pages updated Sep 25 to Oct 3, from the GSC web UI per page (data through Oct 4). Sep 25/26 rewrites compared Sep 11 to 24 vs Sep 27 to Oct 4 per day; site-wide impressions per day fell 10%, so a page only counts as "up" if it beat that. Data files: `Summit-AZ-Early-Check-Page-Metrics-2026-10-05.csv` (33 page rows, before and after) and `Summit-AZ-Early-Check-GSC-Raw-2026-10-05.json`.

# Bottom line
- Oct 1 to 3 changes: too early (2 to 3 days of data).
- Sep 25/26 rewrites: 5 early positive, 3 no meaningful change, 1 drop, 10 not judgeable (7 not yet indexed).
- Clicks still 0 or 1 per page; nothing shows in leads yet.

# Positive movement
- /sewer-line-repair-mesa/: impressions per day 5.7 to 12.8 (+124%); new "sewer line repair" at 9.2 and "sewer line replacement" at 8.0.
- /water-leak-detection-queen-creek/: target terms gained 7 to 12 positions.
- /tankless-water-heater-installation-queen-creek/: +50% impressions; "tankless water heater repair queen creek az" 14.3 to 7.7.
- /plumbing-fixture-installation-in-queen-creek/: first impressions (7 at 10.6).
- New /blog/water-softener-maintenance-checklist/: 16 impressions, target term at 6.4.

# No change or negative
- Leak detection Apache Junction (slab leak term 10.4 to 8.0, rest flat), pipe lining Mesa (own terms flat; page average pulled down by a sewer query).
- Leak detection STV impressions per day -61% but target positions held; /garbage-disposals/ lost only out-of-area impressions; water pressure Scottsdale small and leaning negative.

# Not indexed (Oct 5)
- Water pressure, garbage disposal and water heater Phoenix, faucet and toilet, shower and bath (discovered, never crawled); drain cleaning Scottsdale and Queen Creek (last crawled July, before the rewrite). Not crawled since the rewrite means not yet evaluated, not failed. This led to [Summit AZ - 7 Page Boost 2026-10-07](lib:brain-summit-az-7-page-boost-2026-10-07).
- New snowbird post: 15 impressions at 8.7 in its first days.
